pageHeader.title: Sign-in
pageHeader.description: Let people sign in with an existing account from an identity provider (Google Workspace, Okta, Authentik, and similar), instead of — never instead of — a username and password. Local sign-in always keeps working.

permissionDenied.title: You can't manage sign-in settings
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "Manage panel-wide settings". Ask an administrator to grant it if you need access to this screen.

status.notConfigured: Single sign-on is not configured yet
status.notConfiguredHint: Fill in the provider details below and save to turn it on.

envPinnedNote: Set via an environment variable on this install — edit it there, not here.

sections.providerDescription: How this panel connects to your identity provider, and what to register there.
sections.advancedDescription: Scope and transport options — leave as-is unless your provider needs something different.

providerPresets.label: Provider preset
providerPresets.help: Fills in the issuer URL shape and recommended scope for a known provider. Replace anything in angle brackets with your own values before testing or saving.

fields.issuerUrlHelp: The base URL your identity provider gave you for OpenID Connect — the panel discovers everything else from it.
fields.clientIdHelp: The public identifier your identity provider assigned to this panel when you registered it as an application there — paired with the client secret below, but not sensitive on its own. Copy it from your provider's app registration page.
fields.clientSecretPlaceholderConfigured: Leave unchanged to keep the current secret
fields.clientSecretConfiguredHelp: A secret is already stored — these dots aren't the real value. Leave them as-is to keep it, type a new value to replace it, or clear the field and save to remove sign-in with this provider.
fields.providerNameHelp: Shown on the login screen's button — "Continue with {{name}}".
fields.redirectUriHelp: Paste this exact URL into your identity provider's app registration:
fields.redirectUriConfirmNote: Double-check this matches the web address you actually use to reach this panel — especially http vs. https. Behind a reverse proxy, the panel can't always tell which one your browser used.
fields.scopeHelp: Advanced. Leave as-is unless your provider needs something different.
fields.allowInsecureHttp: Allow plain HTTP for this provider
fields.allowInsecureHttpHelp: Only for a self-hosted identity provider reachable solely over a private, HTTP-only address (e.g. behind a VPN). Never enable this for a provider reachable from the internet.

toasts.settingsSavedDescription: The panel will use the new settings for the next sign-in attempt.
toasts.testSuccessDescription: The panel reached the identity provider and confirmed it accepts these credentials.
